how-it-works.title: DukaanSet Use Karna Shuru Karo

how-it-works.intro: Account banao, shop chuno, products jodo, bill review karo aur din ka hisaab dekho.

sections.title: 01 · Account Banao
sections.body: Naam, email aur password bharo. Verification aur recovery configured email channel use karte hain; SMS OTP ka claim nahi hai.

sections.title: 02 · Shop Chuno
sections.body: Shop ka naam, type aur English, Hindi ya Hinglish chuno. Baaki details baad mein jodo.

sections.title: 03 · Products Jodo
sections.body: Naam, unit, price, cost aur actually available opening quantity bharo.

sections.title: 04 · Bill Review Karo
sections.body: Products, quantity aur received money bharo. Balance baaki ho to customer chuno. Total dekhkar save karo.

sections.title: 05 · Din Ka Haal Dekho
sections.body: Sale, stock movement aur customer balance dekho. Din ke end par cash ginkar closing karo.

help.title: DukaanSet Help Centre
help.description: Bills, stock, payments, business switch aur available services ki jaankari paao.
help.headline: Zaroori Sawaal. Aasaan Help.
help.intro: Bills, stock, payments, business switch aur available services ki jaankari paao.

sections.title: Shuru karein
sections.body: Account banayein, email verify karein, business type chunein aur dukaan ki zaroori details dein. Kuch products jodkar pehli sale check karein.

sections.title: Bill aur split payments
sections.body: Sale mein products jodkar quantity aur prices check karein. Cash aur UPI ki rakam alag likhein. Customer aur baaki balance check karke confirm karein.

sections.title: Stock aur units
sections.body: Har product ki sahi unit rakhein. Purchase receive karke stock jodein; adjustment ka reason likhein. Movement history mein changes dekhein.

sections.title: Customer hisaab aur udhaar
sections.body: Customer profile mein bills, receipts aur baaki balance dekhein. Poore statement ke liye period chunein. Receipt recorded payment batati hai, bank verification nahin.

sections.title: VoiceOS ke drafts
sections.body: Bolein ya command likhein. Speech browser par depend karti hai; AI service ke liye configuration chahiye. Confirm se pehle products, quantity aur amounts check karein. Sirf bolne se transaction nahin hota.

sections.title: DemandPulse requests
sections.body: Na mile product ki maang darj karein. Patterns dekhkar maal mangane par sochein. Customer se contact se pehle sahi permission lein. Asli sale confirm hone par hi request sale banti hai.

sections.title: Bills, PDF aur sharing
sections.body: Saved bill ko Invoice Studio mein kholein. PDF banakar dekhein, phir download ya print karein. WhatsApp par file khud attach karein; official delivery ke liye authorised sender aur approved templates chahiye.

sections.title: Accounts aur password recovery
sections.body: Login par Forgot Password chunein. Email ka recovery link kholkar naya, alag password rakhein. Link expire ho toh naya maangein. File email mode sirf local development ke liye hai.

sections.title: Bhasha settings
sections.body: Language selector se English, Hindi ya Hinglish chunein. Form ki values bani rehti hain. Saved product aur customer names chupke translate hone ke bajaay original records rehte hain.

sections.title: Issue Batao
sections.body: Page, expected result, actual result aur repeat hone ki details do. Device aur browser reproduce karne mein help karte hain.

sections.title: Workflow Suggestion Do
sections.body: Shop type aur real task batao—weight, partial payment, receipt ya closing. Customer-supplier records publish mat karo.

sections.title: Private Details Safe Rakho
sections.body: GitHub issues public hain. Passwords, cookies, identity documents, customer contacts ya full business exports mat bhejo.

about.intro: Indian shopkeepers ke roz ke bills, stock aur payment ko ek saaf workspace mein jodne ka kaam jaari hai.

sections.title: Jis Problem Par Kaam Kar Rahe Hain
sections.body: Alag notebooks, stock lists aur payment records ek sale ko kai tasks bana dete hain. Connected records repeated entry ghata sakte hain.

sections.title: Hamare Principles
sections.body: Aasaan words, saaf next action, kam initial details aur phone layout. Records server par check karo aur availability sach batao.

sections.title: Kaam Jaari Hai
sections.body: Core workflows connected hain. Merchant research, hosting, operational security aur tax/provider review commercial launch se pehle baaki hain.

sections.title: Brand Aur Company Ka Status
sections.body: DukaanSet working product name hai. Registered company, trademark clearance, office ya established customer base ka claim nahi hai.

privacy.note: Draft · Legal Review Zaroori. Yeh Complete Privacy Compliance Ka Claim Nahi Hai.

sections.title: App Kaunsa Data Leta Hai
sections.body: Account mein naam, email aur hashed password hota hai. Business mein products, stock, customers, suppliers, invoices aur payments hain. Sirf zaroori contacts lo.

sections.title: Records Kaise Use Hote Hain
sections.body: Login, allowed business workflows, summaries aur exports mein records use hote hain. AI ko bheje data ka alag review chahiye.

sections.title: Providers Aur Hosting
sections.body: Final policy mein actual hosting, email, AI providers, operator aur cross-border handling batani hogi. Draft advertising consent ka claim nahi karta.

sections.title: Retention Aur Requests
sections.body: Retention, deletion, access, grievance contact aur backup expiry final nahi hain. Export poori privacy-rights process nahi hai.

sections.title: Real Data Daalo To
sections.body: Final notice aur security review karo. Unnecessary identity documents, card details, UPI PIN, bank passwords ya sensitive data mat daalo.

terms.title: Use Ki Terms Ka Draft—Review Baaki

terms.note: Draft · Legal Review Zaroori. Complete Commercial Agreement Abhi Available Nahi Hai.

sections.title: Intended Use
sections.body: Authorized users apne business ke accurate records rakhein. Account safe rakho aur lawful use karo. Demo real financial record nahi hai.

sections.title: Financial Records Aur Services
sections.body: Payment entry bank transfer nahi karti. Normal bill GST e-invoice nahi hai. AI examples tax, accounting ya legal advice nahi hain.

sections.title: Development Ki Limits
sections.body: Availability, backup recovery, support aur specialized features alag verify honi chahiye. Essential records ki protected copies rakho.

sections.title: Subscription Aur Termination
sections.body: Prices, billing periods, cancellation, refunds, suspension aur termination ke baad access abhi final nahi hain. Subscription checkout nahi hai.

sections.title: Baaki Legal Details
sections.body: Operator, contact, applicable law, disputes aur reasonable liability paid launch se pehle tay aur review hone chahiye.

security.title: DukaanSet Security Aur Limits
security.description: Login, business permissions aur transaction checks security ka base hain. Production ka independent review aur operations alag zaroori hain.
security.headline: Private Records. Checked Changes.
security.intro: Login, business permissions aur transaction checks security ka base hain. Production ka independent review aur operations alag zaroori hain.

sections.title: Login Aur Business Isolation
sections.body: Server sessions aur passwords se login hota hai. Har action authorized business ka hai; business switch par records aur permissions badalte hain.

sections.title: Financial Changes Server Par Check Hote Hain
sections.body: Quantity, prices, stock aur payment check hote hain. Invoice, stock aur balance ek transaction mein badalte hain.

sections.title: Private Pages Aur Offline Cache
sections.body: Private pages ko session chahiye aur search indexing se bahar hain. Cache mein sirf public assets aur offline notice hain; private records nahi.

sections.title: Secrets Aur Provider Boundaries
sections.body: Credentials server environment mein rakho. Payments, messaging aur AI ko apne providers chahiye. App UPI PIN ya bank passwords nahi maangta.

sections.title: Production Ki Taiyari
sections.body: HTTPS, access controls, monitoring, restore drills, retention aur independent security review zaroori hain. SOC 2, ISO ya legal compliance ka claim nahi hai.

faqs.question: Kya Phone Par Use Kar Sakte Hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. Phone, tablet aur desktop par chalta hai. HTTPS par install hota hai; offline billing nahi hai.

faqs.question: Stock Aur Baaki Paise Kaise Badalte Hain?
faqs.answer: Confirm karne par sale, stock aur payment saath darj hote hain. Udhaar ke liye customer chuno.

faqs.question: Kya Demo Data Meri Dukaan Mein Aayega?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Demo alag aur fictional hai. Aapke business ke records alag rahenge.

faqs.question: Kya UPI Verify Hota Hai?
faqs.answer: UPI khud darj hota hai. Bank verification aur subscription checkout connected nahi hain.

faqs.question: Kya bolte hi sale save ho jaati hai?
faqs.answer: Nahin. VoiceOS draft banata hai. Action confirm karne se pehle products aur payments check karein.

faqs.question: Kya unavailable products ki maang rakh sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Haan. DemandPulse review aur stock mangane ke liye requests rakhta hai. Requests poori sale ya revenue nahin gini jaati.

faqs.question: Password kaise recover karein?
faqs.answer: Login par Forgot Password chunein, phir email link kholein. Purana link expire ho toh naya maangein.

faqs.question: Kya bills seedhe WhatsApp par bhej sakte hain?
faqs.answer: Downloaded PDF khud share kar sakte hain. Official direct delivery ke liye authorised Meta sender, approved templates aur send ki saaf confirmation chahiye.

v8.customerTitle: Customer ko jaanein. Hisaab saaf rakhein.
v8.customerHint: Customer profile mein saved sales, payment receipts aur chuni hui avadhi ka poora hisaab saath dekhein.
v8.accountClear: Saved bill, split payment aur baaki ₹298 — poora hisaab saaf.
v8.invoiceHint: Saved bill se branded PDF dekhein. Asli file download, print ya share karein. Har document par apni dukaan ki pehchaan rakhein.
v8.documentFlow: Saved bill → PDF dekhein → download, print ya share
v8.manualShare: WhatsApp par file khud share karein
v8.directShare: Official direct delivery ke liye authorised sender aur approved templates chahiye.
v8.industryTitle: Aapke kaam ke tareeke ke liye.
v8.industryHint: Dukaan ka type chunein. Kalpanik records se products, units aur roz ka workflow dekhein.
v8.languageHint: English, Hindi ya Hinglish — records bachakar interface ki bhasha badlein. Neeche preview dekhein.
v8.journeyTag: ACCOUNT SE ROZ KE BHAROSE TAK
v8.journeyHint: Zaroori details se shuru karein. Jab chahiye tab smart tools laayein.
v8.featureTitle: Dohraya kaam kam. Hisaab zyada saaf.
v8.featureHint: Jude records se roz ke paanch kaam aasan. Previews dekhein, phir actual workspace try karein.
v8.sellHint: Bill banayein, split payment likhein aur bill ko stock se jodein.
v8.stockHint: Quantity, units, kharid aur badlaav dekhein. Bolkar draft banayein, phir check karein.
v8.peopleHint: Ek customer profile mein sales, receipts aur baaki rakam dekhein.
v8.opportunitiesHint: Na mile product ki maang yaad rakhein aur sochkar stock mangayein.
v8.understandHint: Aaj ke kaam, reports aur daily closing se dekhein kahaan dhyaan chahiye.
v8.noHelp: Topic nahin mila. Chhota shabd khojein.
v8.pricingHint: Commercial plans tay ho rahe hain. Yeh proposed categories hain, paid checkout nahin. Pehle working demo dekhein.
v8.finalTitle: Agla kaam ka din, thoda aur set.
v8.finalHint: Demo ki kalpanik dukaan dekhein, ya account banakar apne products se shuru karein.
v8.authHint: Sales, stock aur customer records ek aasan workspace mein jude.
v8.passwordShort: Kam se kam 10 characters rakhein. Lamba, alag passphrase behtar hai.
v8.passwordOkay: Zaroori length poori hai. Is account ka alag password rakhein.
v8.passwordStrong: Lamba passphrase. Sirf is account ke liye rakhein.
v8.acceptTerms: Maine terms aur privacy ki jaankari padhi hai.
v8.authDemo: Pehle kalpanik dukaan ka demo dekhein
